headline: On-site reviews of applications for properties at 225 East Main Street, 59 Camp Street, and 234 and 220 Riverside Avenue.
summary: Five applications cover four properties. The visits are open to the public, but no testimony will be taken, and a decision will come at a later meeting.
items: On-site review of #2080 and #26-467F-320 at 225 East Main Street (Map 41, Lot 19), 8:30 AM
On-site review of #2081 at 59 Camp Street (Map 42, Lot 68), 9:00 AM
On-site review of #2066 at 234 Riverside Avenue (Map 30, Lot 117A), 9:30 AM
On-site review of #2082 at 220 Riverside Avenue (Map 30, Lot 117), 9:30 AM
Public may attend, but no testimony will be presented at the reviews
No deliberation or votes at the reviews
Reconvene at City Council Chambers at the next regular meeting to decide on the application
location: On-site at 225 East Main Street, 59 Camp Street, 234 Riverside Avenue, and 220 Riverside Avenue, Bristol
plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Conservation Commission/ 
Inland Wetlands and 
Watercourses Agency 
 
SATURDAY 
NOVEMBER 21, 2026  
 
ON-SITE 
INSPECTION  
BEGINS AT 8:30 AM 
 
 
 
 
                                                  ON-SITE INSPECTIONS AGENDA 
 
There will be on-site inspections held by the Bristol Conservation Commission & Inland 
Wetlands & Watercourses Agency to conduct a review of the properties listed below on 
Saturday, November 21, 2026 beginning at 8:30 AM: 
 
APP. #                    LOCATION                                                                        TIME 
#2080                     225 East Main Street                                                        8:30 AM 
                               (Map 41, Lot 19) 
 
#26-467F-320         225 East Main Street                                                        8:30 AM 
                               (Map 41, Lot 19) 
 
#2081                     59 Camp Street                                                                 9:00 AM 
                               (Map 42, Lot 68) 
 
#2066                     234 Riverside Avenue                                                       9:30 AM 
                               (Map 30, Lot 117A) 
 
#2082                     220 Riverside Avenue                                                       9:30 AM 
                               (Map 30, Lot 117) 
 
  
1. Call to Order 
2. The public is invited but no testimony will be presented at the on-site review. 
3. The Bristol Conservation & Inland Wetlands & Watercourses Agency Commissioners shall 
not deliberate at this on-site review and no votes shall be taken at this time.
4. The Bristol Conservation & Inland Wetlands & Watercourses Agency shall reconvene at 
the City of Bristol City Council Chambers at the next regularly scheduled meeting to make 
a decision on this application. 
5. Adjournment 
  
Per Order of David Rooks, Chairman
